narrative_engine.thesis: Volatility is coiled (ATR percentile 1%, EMA spread -2.01 ATR) — the honest play is patience. Do NOT fade the range: compression resolves explosively, and the highest-value action is standing ready with the M1 pullback plan the moment a stack aligns.

athena_oracle.verdict: Constructive bullish lean 60/100 — trend aligned, flow confirming, ask-wall ceiling
